name: Bond USD0
oneLiner: bUSD0 is Usual's bond-leg wrapper of USD0, splitting deposited USD0 into a fixed-notional bond token plus a separate early-exit right redeemable at maturity.
collateral: Locked USD0 bond position backed by the Usual USD0 reserve stack; bUSD0 is the fixed-notional bond leg formerly known as USD0++
pegMechanism: Depositing 1 USD0 mints 1 bUSD0 plus 1 rt-bUSD0 early-exit right; before June 11, 2028 par redemption requires both tokens, while bUSD0 alone redeems 1:1 for USD0 at maturity and may trade below par before then

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Explicit Possible retained: reviewed metadata indicates direct token, vault, issuer, pause, proxy, or admin-control uncertainty, but available registry sources do not prove an active holder-balance blacklist path.

mintAuthority.summary: bUSD0 is Usual's bond-maturity wrapper of USD0; depositing 1 USD0 mints 1 bUSD0 against locked USD0, which does not create base USD0 supply, so its mint authority is inherited from USD0 (usd0-usual).

controls.label: Usual bUSD0 bond-leg token
controls.capDescription: bUSD0 is minted/burned by the Usual bond contract against locked USD0 (1 USD0 in -> 1 bUSD0 + 1 rt-bUSD0 out, redeemable at maturity); this bond accounting cannot create or destroy base USD0 supply.
controls.evidence: Bond-maturity wrapper: bUSD0 represents a fixed-notional bond claim on locked USD0; minting follows USD0 deposits into the bond contract and does not expand the parent USD0 monetary base.

controls.label: Inherited USD0 (Usual) issuer mint path
controls.evidence: Underlying USD0 supply is created via Usual's protocol-operated issuer mint authority against RWA collateral (issuer-direct-mint, concentrated-admin); bUSD0 locks USD0 and inherits that base mint authority.

review.evidence: bUSD0 (variantOf usd0-usual, variantKind bond-maturity) is a bond-leg wrapper whose supply tracks locked USD0; base mint authority is the inherited Usual USD0 issuer path (concentrated-admin) and is mirrored here.
review.sourceFreeRationale: Wrapper classification follows from coin metadata (variantOf usd0-usual, bond-maturity, locked-USD0 wrapper reserve); posture mirrors the USD0 parent mint authority.
